bottleneck_link: F-star (cert(M) >= floor(2v/3), research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas section 7) is the named route to closing every open T = 3 window at once. After PR 3012 the box-floor route survives exactly on the tau >= 1 domain, PROVEN for v <= 4 and open first at v = 5 (threshold 3). This package settles v = 5 (PROVEN) and narrows the shareable-class remainder.
evidence: VERDICT (a): the tau >= 1 box floor HOLDS at v = 5 - PROVEN. Chain: (1) exhaustive combinatorial envelope classification over all 749398 multisets of 5 raw line types with tau >= 1 (joint bit structure preserved): box = 2 on the envelope forces exactly 33 families, all of the rank-2-cap + all-pairs-even shape; (2) the anchor-attainment screen (a0 omits bit j everywhere => p_j == 0; b0 omits bit j everywhere <=> q_j == 0 or c_j > gamma) rejects 15 of the 33 as unrealizable and leaves 6 shapes up to total relabeling (5 unshareable-total rank-3 shapes + 1 zero-p-column rank-2 shape); (3) exact blocking-Z enumeration per surviving shape (per-triple kept-3 feasibility tables, all 2^20 arc subsets): the ONLY zero-arc set blocking every triple is the complete digraph; complete Z forces M diagonal, rank(M) = 5 > 3, impossible for any 3-total decoder. Hence box >= 3 = floor(2v/3) for every exact 3-total rational decoder with v = 5 and tau >= 1. Corroboration: 120 realizable tau >= 1 v = 5 decoders (tau-forced generator) all have exact box >= 5 with replayed in-box witnesses; a 35-instance hunt (tau-targeted, PR 2978-core extensions, nullspace-dense) finds 0 falsifiers. VERDICT (b): PR 2978's 3/3/21 classification replayed exactly (same seed and stages); the cap push (exact kernel q-solver, 10000 P-restarts per pattern, plus the vendored big alphabet at 2000) realizes none of the 21; one pattern is PROVEN unrealizable ((a0,b0) = (3^3,3^3) with complete Z: A1 gives p_2 == 0 so rank(M) <= 2, but complete Z forces diagonal rank 3); the remaining 20 stay CHECKED not-found-in-cap (all 20 are shareable class r_box = 3; the proven-unrealizable one forces r_box = 2, correcting PR 3012's 'all 21' framing). VERDICT (c): F-star is NOT proved and NOT refuted; cert >= floor(2v/3) has survived every falsifier test in the lineage, and the box floor is now PROVEN on the full tau >= 1 domain for v <= 5.
existing_restriction_being_changed: PR 3012 recorded the tau >= 1 box floor as 'PROVEN for v <= 4, bounded at v = 5 (240 instances, 0 below threshold), first open case v = 5'. This package converts the bounded v = 5 evidence into a proof by exhaustive envelope classification plus exact blocking-Z enumeration, and settles one of the 21 shareable-class patterns.
falsification_test: The v = 5 floor claim is falsified by any exact 3-total rational decoder with v = 5, tau >= 1 everywhere and exact box <= 2 (ladder-exact; both sides certified by replayed witnesses). The envelope classification is falsified by any 5-line type multiset with envelope box = 2 outside the 33 recorded families (the enumeration is exhaustive over 749398 multisets and re-runs from scratch). The blocking-Z claim is falsified by any surviving shape and any non-complete arc subset that blocks all ten triples (per-triple tables are exact kept-3 feasibility). The shareable replay is falsified by a pattern whose replay status differs from 3 realized / 3 unrealizable-column / 21 not-found-in-cap.

method: Smallest falsifying instance first. (1) Written reduction: box depends only on (a0, b0, Z) and is monotone non-increasing in Z; Lemma SG forces Z inside the even pairs; so a realizable box-2 decoder must sit inside a box-2 combinatorial envelope. (2) Exhaustive envelope enumeration at v = 5 (749398 raw-type multisets; cheap singleton-witness test memoized, exact kept-set ladder as fallback; ladder pinned to the independent definition-level brute enumeration on 400 random configs). (3) Anchor-attainment screen (engine-definition facts) on the 33 families. (4) Exact blocking-Z enumeration per surviving shape (2^20 subsets against exact per-triple blocking tables) with the rank obstruction recorded. (5) Realizable replay on 120 tau-forced decoders; bounded falsifier hunt (35 instances). (6) Shareable class: exact replay of PR 2978's realize pipeline (same seed), then a cap push with an exact kernel q-solver. Int-only arithmetic; every acceptance engine-checked with replayed witnesses.
